## Import

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(broom)
library(glue)
library(plotgardener)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(sjPlot)
library(gtools)
setwd("~/gitcode/DNAm")
`%nin%` = negate(`%in%`) 
DATE = '20250713'
# DATE = ymd(Sys.Date()) %>% str_replace_all("-", "")

## Extract tidy results and standardized coefficents
get_std_res <- function(model) {
    std_res <- standardize_parameters(model, method = "refit") %>% as_tibble()

    if (inherits(model, "merMod")) {
        res <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, effects = "fixed") 
     } else {                                  # anything that is not merMod
        res <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = T) 
    }

    return(left_join(res, std_res, by = c('term' = 'Parameter')))
}

```

```{r}
## Import 
#| include: false 

adni <- read_csv(glue('intermediate/adni_{DATE}.csv')) %>%
  mutate(
    apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3"), 
    educ_cat = fct_relevel(educ_cat, 'HighSchool')
  )

cog.df <- adni %>% 
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice_min(PHC_Visit) %>%
  ungroup()

mri.df <- read_csv(glue('intermediate/mri_{DATE}.csv')) %>%
 mutate(
   apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3"), 
   educ_cat = fct_relevel(educ_cat, 'HighSchool')
 )

flbm.df <- read_csv(glue('intermediate/flbm_{DATE}.csv')) %>%
 mutate(
   apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3"), 
   educ_cat = fct_relevel(educ_cat, 'HighSchool')
 )

adni %>% 
  select(RID, gbl_cog, yrs_c, nk_cell, z_dnam_bl)
```

## Analysis
### Global Cognition 
#### Baseline Models
```{r}
fitlmer.00 <- lmer(gbl_cog ~ yrs_c + (yrs_c  | RID), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.00)

cog_bl_cov <- "yrs_c + z_age_bl + sex + educ + cdrsb_bl + apoe + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

fitlmer.01 <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bl_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)")), 
                  REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.01)

fitlmer.02a <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02a) 

fitlmer.02b <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02b)

fitlmer.02c <- lmer(as.formula(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_mtcn_bl + {cog_bl_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)")), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02c)
```

```{r}
cog_bllm_cov <- "z_age_bl + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl + apoe + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl + causage_bl + tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl * causage_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl + causage_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  mtcn_bl * causage_bl + tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()
lm(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_bllm_cov}  +  causage_bl + mtcn_bl * tl_bl"), data = cog.df) %>% tidy()

```

#### Longitudinal
```{r}

cog_lt_cov <- "yrs_c + z_age_bl*yrs_c + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl*yrs_c + apoe*yrs_c + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

## Longitudional
fitlmer.03 <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03)

fitlmer.03a <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03a)
plot_model(fitlmer.03a, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_tl_bl"))

fitlmer.03b <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03b)
plot_model(fitlmer.03b, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_dnam_bl"))

fitlmer.03c <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03c)
plot_model(fitlmer.03c, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))

fitlmer.03d <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_tl_bl*yrs_c + z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03d)

plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_tl_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_dnam_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))
```

```{r}

gbl_cog_bioage.res <- bind_rows(
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "baseline"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03a) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "TL"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03b) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "CausAge"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03c) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "mtDNAcn"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.03d) %>% mutate(outcome = 'gbl_cog', model = "BioAge")
  ) %>%
  relocate(outcome, model) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = signif(estimate, 2),
    std.error = signif(std.error, 2),
    p.value_fmt = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),              
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}{sig}")
  ) 
  
gbl_cog_bioage.res  %>% 
  print(n = Inf)

```

```{r}
gbl_cog_tl.p <- plot_model(fitlmer.03d, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_tl_bl")) +
```

```{r}
fitlmer.04c <- lmer(glue("gbl_cog ~ z_dnam_bl*z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
```

```{r}
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),      
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}")
  ) 
  
gbl_cog_x.res  %>%
```

### Cogntive Domains
#### Episodic Memory
```{r}

cog_lt_cov <- "yrs_c + z_age_bl*yrs_c + sex + educ_cat + cdrsb_bl*yrs_c + apoe*yrs_c + nk_cell_bl + b_cell_bl + cd4_t_cell_bl + cd8_t_cell_bl + monocyte_bl"

## Longitudional
fitlmer.mem_tl <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_tl_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_dnam <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_mtcn <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

fitlmer.mem_bioag <- lmer(
      glue("PHC_MEM ~ z_tl_bl*yrs_c + z_dnam_bl*yrs_c + z_mtcn_bl*yrs_c + {cog_lt_cov} + (yrs_c  | RID)"),
      REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl('optimx', optCtrl=list(method='nlminb')), data = adni
  )

summary(fitlmer.mem_bioag)
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_tl_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_dnam_bl"))
plot_model(fitlmer.mem_bioag, type = "pred", terms = c("yrs_c", "z_mtcn_bl"))

  )
```

```{r}
mem.res <- bind_rows(
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_tl) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "TL", predictor = 'TL'),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_mtcn) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcn", predictor = 'mtDNAcn'),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_dnam) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "CausAge", predictor = 'CausAge'),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_bioag) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "BioAge"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_dnam_tl) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "DNAmxTL"),

  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_dnam_mtcn) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAm"),
  get_std_res(fitlmer.mem_bioag_x ) %>% mutate(outcome = 'mem', model = "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL"),
) %>% 
  mutate(
    estimate = signif(estimate, 2),
    std.error = signif(std.error, 2),
    p.value_fmt = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),              # decimal (3 places)
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),      
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}")
  ) 
  
```

```{r}
      p.value < 0.001,
      formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2),  # scientific notation
      as.character(round(p.value, 3))),              # decimal (3 places)
    sig = stars.pval(p.value),      
    out = glue("{estimate} ({std.error}), p = {p.value_fmt}")
  ) 
```
  

```{r}
csf_coef.p <- csf.res %>%
  filter(term %in% c('z_mtcn', 'z_dnam', 'z_tl')) %>%
  mutate(
    term = case_when(
      term == "z_mtcn" ~ 'mtDNAcn', 
      term == "z_dnam" ~ 'CausAge', 
      term == "z_tl" ~ 'TL'
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = estimate, y = term)) + 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(outcome)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient Estimate (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

csf_coef.p
```

```{r}
    term = case_when(
      term == "mtcn_bl" ~ 'mtDNAcn', 
      term == "causage_bl" ~ 'CausAge', 
      term == "tl_bl" ~ 'TL'
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = estimate, y = term)) + 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(outcome), scales = 'free') + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient Estimate (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: results_all

cog_summary.res <- bind_rows(
    mem.res, 
    exf.res, 
    lan.res, 
    vsp.res
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    endophenotype = 'Cognition',
    model = ifelse(str_detect(model, 'CausAge'), "DNAm", model),
    model2 = case_when(
      model %in% c('TL', 'DNAm', 'mtDNAcn') ~ 'Single',
      model == 'BioAge' ~ 'Joint', 
      str_detect(model, "x") ~ 'Interaction',
    ),
    model = case_when(
      model == 'BioAge' & str_detect(term, 'z_tl_bl') ~ 'TL',
      model == 'BioAge' & str_detect(term, 'z_mtcn_bl') ~ 'mtDNAcn',
      model == 'BioAge' & str_detect(term, 'z_dnam_bl') ~ "DNAm",
      TRUE ~ model
    ),
    outcome = fct_recode(outcome, 'Memory' = 'mem', "Language" = 'lan', 'Executive Function' = 'exf', 'Visuospatial ability' = 'vsp'),
    outcome = case_when(
      str_detect(term, "yrs") ~ paste0(outcome, " Decline"), 
      TRUE ~ outcome
    ),
    term = if_else(
      str_detect(term, ":"),
      map_chr(str_split(term, ":"), ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ":")),
      term
    )
  ) %>% 
  relocate(outcome, model, model2) %>%
  filter(str_detect(term, "mtcn|dnam|tl")) %>%
  filter(!(model2 == 'Interaction' & !str_detect(term, ":"))) %>%
  filter(!(model2 == 'Interaction' & term %in% c("yrs_c:z_tl_bl", "yrs_c:z_dnam_bl", "yrs_c:z_mtcn_bl"))) %>%
  filter(!(model == "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL" & str_count(term, ":") < 2)) %>%
  filter(!(model == "mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL" & str_count(term, ":") == 2 & str_detect(term, "yrs_c"))) %>%
  mutate(  
    term = model, 
    model = model2
  ) %>% 
  select(-model2)

res.df <- res %>% 
  select(endophenotype, outcome, model, term, Std_Coefficient, CI_low, CI_high, p.value) %>%
  # pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      p.value < 0.05               ~ "\u2713",  # check mark ✓
      p.value >= 0.05 & p.value < 0.1 ~ "\u2022",  # bullet •
      p.value >= 0.1               ~ "\u2717"   # cross ✗
    ), 
    sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE),
    model = fct_relevel(model, 'Single', 'Joint','Interaction'), 
    term = fct_relevel(term, 'mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL'), 
    outcome = fct_relevel(outcome, 'Global Cognition', 'Global Cognitive Decline', 'Memory', 'Memory Decline'),
    endophenotype = case_when(
      str_detect(outcome, "Decline") ~ "Longitudinal Cog.", 
      endophenotype == 'Cognition' ~ 'Baseline Cog.', 
      TRUE ~ endophenotype
    ), 
    endophenotype = fct_relevel(endophenotype, 'Baseline Cog.', "Longitudinal Cog.")
  )
```

```{r}
## 1.  Create a page (all units are inches)
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
int_width = 7.5
int_height = 9.5

png(glue("results/plots/coeff_interactions_{DATE}.png"),  width = int_width, height = int_height, units = "in", res = 300)

pageCreate(
  width  = int_width,   # “full-page width” (slightly narrower than US-letter 8.5")
  height = int_height,    # choose a height that works for you
)

## Convenience variables -------------------------------------------------
pad   <- 0.125              # horizontal / vertical padding between panels
row1h <- 3.2                 # height of the first row   (plots A)
row2h <- 3                 # height of the second row  (plots B–D)
row3h <- 3                 # height of the third row   (plot  E)

## x-coordinates for the three tiles on the 2nd row
col_w <- (7.5 - 2*pad) / 2         # width of each of the three equal columns
x2    <- c(0, col_w + pad, 2*(col_w + pad))

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 2.  Row-1  : plot A  (full width)
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotGG(
  plot = int.p,                 # your ggplot object
  x      = 0, 
  y      = 0, 
  width  = 7.5, 
  height = row1h,
  just   = c("left", "top"),      # anchor upper-left
  default.units = "inches"
)

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 3.  Row-2  : plots B, C, D
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotGG(gbl_cog_mtcnxtl.p,
       x = x2[1],
       y = row1h + pad,           # below first row
       width  = col_w,
       height = row2h,
       just   = c("left", "top"),
       default.units = "inches")

plotGG(lan_dnam_mtcn.p,
       x = x2[2],
       y = row1h + pad,
       width  = col_w,
       height = row2h,
       just   = c("left", "top"),
       default.units = "inches")


## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 4.  Row-3  : plot E  (full width)
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plotGG(
  plot = gmvol_mtcnxdnamxtl.p,
  x      = 0,
  y      = row1h + pad + row2h + pad,     # below second row
  width  = 7.5,
  height = row3h,
  just   = c("left", "top"),
  default.units = "inches"
)

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 5.  Export, if desired
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pageGuideHide()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: export_cog_results


cog_bioage.out <- bind_rows(
    gbl_cog_bioage.res, gbl_cog_x.res, 
    mem.res, 
    exf.res, 
    lan.res, 
    vsp.res
  ) %>%
  filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
  select(outcome, model, term, estimate, std.error, p.value_fmt, sig) %>%
  mutate(
    term = if_else(
      str_detect(term, ":"),
      map_chr(str_split(term, ":"), ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ":")),
      term
    )
  ) %>%
  # Combine p.value_fmt and sig into one column
  unite(p, c("p.value_fmt", "sig"), sep = " ") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from   = model,
    values_from  = c(estimate, std.error, p),
    names_glue   = "{.value}_{model}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    effect = ifelse(str_detect(term, "yrs"), "longitudinal", "baseline"), 
    term = fct_relevel(term, 
      "(Intercept)", "z_age_bl", "sexMale", "educ_catCollege", "educ_catGraduate", "cdrsb_bl", "apoee2+", "apoee4+",
      "nk_cell_bl", "b_cell_bl", "cd4_t_cell_bl", "cd8_t_cell_bl", "monocyte_bl" , 
      "z_tl_bl",  "z_dnam_bl", "z_mtcn_bl", "z_dnam_bl:z_tl_bl", "z_mtcn_bl:z_tl_bl", "z_dnam_bl:z_mtcn_bl", "z_dnam_bl:z_mtcn_bl:z_tl_bl", 
      "yrs_c", "yrs_c:z_age_bl", "cdrsb_bl:yrs_c", "apoee2+:yrs_c", "apoee4+:yrs_c", 
      "yrs_c:z_tl_bl", "yrs_c:z_dnam_bl", "yrs_c:z_mtcn_bl", "yrs_c:z_mtcn_bl:z_tl_bl", "yrs_c:z_dnam_bl:z_mtcn_bl", "yrs_c:z_dnam_bl:z_tl_bl" , "yrs_c:z_dnam_bl:z_mtcn_bl:z_tl_bl"    
      )                             
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    outcome, term, effect, 
    ends_with("_baseline"), 
    ends_with("_TL"), 
    ends_with("_CausAge"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcn"), 
    ends_with("_bioage"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxTL"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxDNAm"), 
    ends_with("_DNAmxTL"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL")
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, effect, term)

cog_bioage.out

cog_bioage.out  %>%
  write_csv(glue('results/cog_results_{DATE}.csv'), na = "")

```

```{r}
#| label: export_csf_results

csf_res.out <- csf.res %>%
  mutate(
    sig = stars.pval(p.value), 
    term = if_else(
      str_detect(term, ":"),
      map_chr(str_split(term, ":"), ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ":")),
      term
    ), 
    term = fct_relevel(term, 
      "(Intercept)", "age", "sex", "cdrsb", 'apoee2+', "apoee4+", "b_cell", "cd4_t_cell", "cd8_t_cell", "nk_cell", "monocyte", 
      "z_tl", "z_dnam", "z_mtcn", "z_dnam:z_mtcn", "z_mtcn:z_tl", "z_dnam:z_tl", "z_dnam:z_mtcn:z_tl"
      )
  ) %>%
  # Combine p.value_fmt and sig into one column 
  select(outcome, model, term, estimate, std.error, p.value_fmt, sig) %>%
  unite(p, c("p.value_fmt", "sig"), sep = " ") %>%
    pivot_wider(
    names_from   = model,
    values_from  = c(estimate, std.error, p),
    names_glue   = "{.value}_{model}"
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    outcome, term, 
    ends_with("_baseline"), 
    ends_with("_TL"), 
    ends_with("_DNAm"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcn"), 
    ends_with("_bioage"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxTL"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxDNAm"), 
    ends_with("_DNAmxTL"), 
    ends_with("_mtDNAcnxDNAmxTL")
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, term)

csf_res.out  %>%
  write_csv(glue('results/csf_results_{DATE}.csv'), na = "")

```
